western/aspects/orbs.yaml.bodies: Sun through Pluto, optional Chiron, nodes and Part of Fortune, plus Ascendant and MC.
western/aspects/orbs.yaml.method: Use shortest circular separation. Accept absolute deviation ≤ orb. Minor aspects opt-in. Proposed editorial orbs require review; transits, directions and synastry each need separate orb profiles.

western/personal-horoscopes/compose.yaml.daily: Select a personal transit approaching perfection today, show the natal point and local date. Weekly lists dated contacts in chronological order and groups repeat passes.
western/personal-horoscopes/compose.yaml.separation: General sign-wide content has its own label and index.

houses.assignment: Follow forward zodiacal order from each cusp, inclusive, to the next cusp, exclusive. Whole-sign house one begins at zero degrees of the tropical rising sign. At polar Placidus failure use whole sign only with a valid Ascendant and label the fallback.

western/profile.yaml.longitude: Geocentric apparent ecliptic longitude of date. Normalize to [0,360). Signs are equal half-open sectors starting at the March equinox.
western/profile.yaml.outer_planets: Use the existing KB-02b entries and their personal-contact filters; sign placements alone supply cohort context.
western/profile.yaml.patterns: Distinct natal bodies from the ten-planet list only; apply all required edges to the same instant. Canonicalize by member set and apex. A maximal sign cluster counts once.
western/profile.yaml.phase_index: For secondary lunar phases take floor(((progressed Moon minus progressed Sun) mod 360)/45). Index zero begins at conjunction. A change is a solved crossing of a sector boundary.

public.evidence: Bodies, orbs, exact times, house method and pattern members are available for chart evidence. No score in public copy.
public.label: Western (tropical)
public.selection: Cooperative testimony may give Supportive; tension needing attention may give Take care; mixed or neutral testimony gives Steady. Use only supported natal or timing facts. Omit unresolved readings.

western/profile.yaml.quincunx: Enable the minor aspect for stand-alone quincunx or Yod queries.
western/profile.yaml.timing: Use the six configured angles with their timing orb. Find exact times by solving continuous longitude against both oriented branches, including station tangencies. Unknown natal positions suppress dependent contacts. Solar arcs use a separate existing module.
